ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution characterized by a ~60:40 ratio of high-intensity white/light-gray pixels to low-intensity black/dark-brown pixels across the visible ventral surfaces.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe: Contiguous high-intensity white field from the lateral tip to the medial center, bounded by a dark perimeter. Right lobe: Fragmented white field with significant dark pixel mottling and focal spots clustered in the upper-medial quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an approximate 45-degree angle at the vertex, separating the two lobes at the lower-central axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations; visible peaks and valleys along the entire upper boundary with pixel amplitudes ranging from 5 to 20 pixels in depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward curve originating from the median notch and tapering to sharp, slightly recurved lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Circular clusters of dark pixels concentrated along the high-contrast transition zone of the trailing edge, particularly on the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark linear pixel streaks (rake marks) visible on the white field of the right lobe, oriented diagonally toward the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable jagged, irregular loss of surface area at the extreme right lateral tip, indicating potential historical physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetrical pigmentation density; the left lobe displays a significantly more uniform high-intensity region than the heavily mottled right lobe.
